description: This file defines an interface for providing factories related to PSR-17 in the Slim Framework. It specifies static methods for getting, setting, and adding factory identifiers.

classes.name: Psr17FactoryProviderInterface
classes.description: An interface declaring static methods for managing factory identifiers for PSR-17 components in Slim Framework.

methods.name: getFactories
methods.description: Returns an array of factory class names.

methods.name: setFactories
methods.description: Sets the list of factory class names.

methods.name: addFactory
methods.description: Adds a single factory class name to the list.
